notes.title: 🪣 Items Update
notes.content:
📷 Camera scale was bumped up to make gameplay 🔍 bigger on screen! Previous scale was too zoomed out, making it hard to 👀see what was happening. Now the 🎮 action should be much easier to follow! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/22a3d81117305844a38a70af1f91f4c9f969d306.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/8ee84ada2440cea7337a7dae4b1f782c2dfee0c7.png
All items became 🪨 physical objects. You can 💎 share them between players, drop them, or 💀 grab items from dead players.  You can also 🔍 search boxes to find new stuff.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/d3469ea593c240ff05b11439abe57662b02ea608.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/f0c881aebacb4a32dd7b1b75ab7e1fbadff7b957.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545591/8ee84ada2440cea7337a7dae4b1f782c2dfee0c7.png
🔫 Bullets became physical objects and can 🫙 run out. Different types of bullets fit only 🎯 specific guns by caliber.
